milestone_description: Assembling the two children: $H_{3}(t)=\mathrm{sm3Count}(t)$ from the bijection, and $\mathrm{sm3Count}(t)=3\binom{t+3}{4}+\binom{t+2}{2}$ from the parameter count. The result is a **polynomial** in $t$ of degree $4=(3-1)^{2}$, the order-three case of the Ehrhart/Stanley theorem that $H_{n}$ is a polynomial of degree $(n-1)^{2}$ — in contrast with the magic count $M_{3}$, which is only a quasi-polynomial.
